(#65, added in #70). The system prompt now has pi's sections: what the model is, the tools it gets, pi's rules, and the working directory. Before, the model got none of these. See [The system prompt](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.0/docs/prompts.md#the-system-prompt).
- **`SYSTEM.md` and `APPEND_SYSTEM.md`** (#67, added in #72). `SYSTEM.md` replaces pi's base sections, and `APPEND_SYSTEM.md` adds text after them, as in pi.
